subject: general
question: Level of significance is:
solution:
**The Correct Answer is :Probability of Type I Error**

__**Explanation:**__

The **level of significance** in hypothesis testing is the **probability of rejecting the null hypothesis when it is actually true**, which is exactly the **Probability of Type I Error**.

∴** Probability of Type I Error**

**Explanation of other options:**

 
• 
 
**2) 1 − Probability of Type I Error** → This is the **confidence level**, not the level of significance.

 
 
• 
 
**3) 1 − Probability of Type II Error** → This is the **power of the test**, the chance of correctly rejecting a false null.

 
 
• 
 
**4) Probability of Type II Error** → This is **β**, the probability of failing to reject a false null.

 

So level of significance = **α = P(Type I Error)**.
